newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle Thursday roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle Thursday roundup - USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow in the Panhandle area Thursday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were not well tested and feedlots reported light inquiry from buyers.
Confirmed - 1,300 Last Week - 17,800 Year Ago - None
Wk to date - 131,300 Last Week - 88,400 Year Ago - 55,500

Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 65.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 64.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 65.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 63.50-64.50.

Sales reported on 500 head slaughter steers and 800 heifers; 131,300 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 34,900 formulated and 200 previously contracted cattle to be shipped this week and 2,400 head or 59 loads CME cattle deliveries.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
